Do not copy its buildings or road arrangement into this different region. Guide boxes indicate location and camera, not identical architecture.

This prompt is a production request, not evidence that geometry/seams already match. Save full native RGBA source; never script-edit generated pixels. Final control-point registration and seam review follow generation.
